description: This PHP source file defines the class OA_Dal_Maintenance_Common, a base Data Abstraction Layer (DAL) class for maintenance processes, including methods for logging and retrieving maintenance process run information, and fetching delivery limitations for ads or channels.

classes.name: OA_Dal_Maintenance_Common
classes.description: A base DAL class providing methods for logging and retrieving maintenance process data, including process run info and delivery limitations.

methods.name: setProcessLastRunInfo
methods.description: Logs data about the times that maintenance processes ran, including start/end times, duration, and optional process type.

methods.name: getProcessLastRunInfo
methods.description: Retrieves data about the last run time of maintenance processes, with support for alternate raw data sources.

methods.name: getMaintenanceStatisticsLastRunInfo
methods.description: Returns the last run info for maintenance statistics, including the update type.

methods.name: getAllDeliveryLimitationsByTypeId
methods.description: Fetches all delivery limitations associated with an ad or channel by ID.
